_comment: Index of source assets surveyed during the burn v2 seed salvage sweep. Records what was looked at, what was ported, what was skipped and why. Machine-readable counterpart to reports/bootscape-salvage.md.

bootscape.kind: OSRS-era Jagex client + server in TypeScript + RS2 scripts

surveyed.notes: chicken, cow, goblin, hill_giant already defined in data/droptables.js. Added man, woman, farmer, giant_rat, skeleton, unicorn, werewolf, zombie, pirate, moss_giant.
OSRS track names not useful since our audio-manifest.json ships an authored Aelgard cue set. Borrowed the region-to-cue mapping table structure only.
59 RS2 quest scripts (quest_arena through quest_zombie). Our src/content/aelgard/quests-*.js already defines 69 Aelgard-native quests. Porting OSRS quests would duplicate and off-theme the setting.
RS2 scripts, not data. Our src/content/aelgard/shops-expanded.js already covers Aelgard shops.
Area names are OSRS (alkharid, ardougne, camelot, falador, draynor, varrock, etc). Aelgard uses its own regions (heartlands, moryskah, etc). Port would be off-theme.
Our data/relationships.js + content/aelgard/training-methods.js + skill-web.js are complete. Skill scripts are implementation, not data.

surveyed.kind: binary packs (loc, npc, obj, model, anim, seq)
surveyed.notes: Binary asset packs. Cannot be parsed without the bootscape toolchain and would be OSRS-themed regardless.
Contains a level-up interface schema, not data. Our engine handles level-ups via src/engine/breakpoint-runner.js hooked to rel.defineBreakpoint().

rejection_criteria: Name is OSRS-specific (Alkharid, Falador, Varrock) and would off-theme Aelgard
Asset is a binary blob (cache.pack) requiring bootscape toolchain
Content already exists in richer form in data/* or src/content/aelgard/*
Content is engine implementation (RS2 scripts), not authorable data
